gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Panasonic's own US store lists the SC-PM270 home CD/Bluetooth system at $139.99 and shows it unavailable today, while the Shanling EC Play, the one portable here that both sends and receives Bluetooth, is in stock at $199.
standout_why: I compared against rottenwifi.com and howtovr.com. av.com and the Coby and GPX retailer pages returned 403, so I couldn't read them. rottenwifi prices only budget players ($25–$50 Gueray, MEGATEK, Deluxe and JENSEN CD-60R-BT models) and none above $50. howtovr lists the Panasonic SC-PM270 with no price and gives no prices at all. Neither page prices the FiiO DM13, Shanling EC Play or Panasonic, or says the Panasonic is out of stock at Panasonic's store. Rivals already give some category pricing at the budget end, and I could not price most of the cards ChatGPT showed (Coby, GPX, FiiO DM13). So the finding fills in only part of the category.
decides: It weakens the Panasonic SC-PM270 as the home pick: the maker's store has it at $139.99 but shows it unavailable on 2026-11-17, so the page needs another retailer link or a backup home pick. It confirms the Shanling EC Play as the portable to name for both directions at $199, in stock at Linsoul. The FiiO DM13 stays the transmit-to-headphones pick on specs, but I could not confirm a current US price for it; ChatGPT's card showed $184.99.

Where it loses, per our current page: it transmits SBC only, while the DM13 transmits aptX HD.
